description: Choose a Jumia storefront and a way to collect products: keyword search, category, flash deals, product URLs, seller storefronts, or brand pages.

brand.description: Brand name, slug or brand URL. Used by the brand mode and to narrow search/category results. Examples: samsung, apple, tecno, or https://www.jumia.com.ng/brands/apple/.
brand.title: Brand

categorySlug.description: A category path or a friendly key. Examples: phones-tablets, electronics, fashion, home-office. The actor translates the key to the selected market's own URL (for example telephone-tablette on jumia.ma). A full Jumia category URL also works.
categorySlug.title: Category

condition.description: Filter by product condition. Jumia exposes new items, refurbished items and packaging-damaged items through different filters.
condition.title: Condition

country.description: The active Jumia country storefront to use. Prices are returned in that market's local currency.
enumTitles: South Africa - closed, no retail storefront
country.title: Jumia storefront

enrichDetails.description: Open each product page found in a listing to add description, specifications, seller score, warranty, return policy and the image gallery. Slower and more request-heavy.
enrichDetails.title: Add full product details

expressOnly.description: Keep products fulfilled through Jumia Express.
expressOnly.title: Jumia Express only

includeReviews.description: For product detail and enriched listings, read the product's review pages and add them to the record.
includeReviews.title: Include full reviews

keyword.description: Product words to search for. Also narrows brand listings when set.
keyword.title: Keyword

maxItems.description: Stop after this many product records. Jumia caps one listing at 2,000 products (50 pages); enable price partitioning to combine bands.
maxItems.title: Maximum products

maxPages.description: How many listing pages to read, about 40 products per page. Jumia shows at most 50 pages for one listing.
maxPages.title: Maximum listing pages

maxPrice.description: Highest price to keep, in the selected market's local currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxReviews.description: How many customer reviews to include per product when full reviews are enabled.
maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews

minDiscount.description: Keep products discounted by at least this percentage.
minDiscount.title: Minimum discount

minPrice.description: Lowest price to keep, in the selected market's local currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Keep products rated at least this many stars (0-5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minSellerScore.description: Keep products from sellers above a Jumia seller-score band.
minSellerScore.title: Minimum seller score

mode.description: How to find products. Search uses a keyword, category browses a catalog section, flashSales reads today's deals, productDetails opens specific URLs, sellerProducts reads a seller storefront, and brandProducts reads a brand page.
mode.title: Collection mode

officialStoreOnly.description: Keep products sold by brand-authorised official stores.
officialStoreOnly.title: Official stores only

partitionByPrice.description: Split a large request into price bands and merge them by product SKU. Use this to go past one listing's 2,000-product / 50-page slice.
partitionByPrice.title: Partition large runs by price

productUrls.description: Jumia product page URLs for the specific product mode. The market is detected from each URL.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

sellerUrls.description: Seller storefront URLs (or slugs like 'jckm-cod') for the seller mode. A full seller profile URL is accepted too.
sellerUrls.title: Seller URLs or slugs

sort.description: Order of listing results, using the sort options Jumia itself offers.
sort.title: Sort order

title: Jumia marketplace input
